name: Stefano Bodini
bio: I am a cloud architect with a passion for big data and microservices. I have been working in the tech industry in various roles, encompassing system integration and IT governance, and I am currently building solutions for multi channel customer engagement. In addition to my work in tech, I am also a passionate guitar player. I have been playing guitar for over 15 years, and I enjoy playing a variety of genres, rock and blues in particular.
